featuresSection.subtitle: From template creation to verified delivery — every step is automated, secured, and auditable.

features.templatesDesc: Build document templates with dynamic placeholders, conditional blocks, and loop support. Connect to any internal or external database table.
features.bulkPdfDesc: Generate hundreds of personalized PDFs from a CSV upload or multiple record IDs in one batch. Automatic approver assignment included.
features.esignDesc: Approvers review the PDF then confirm approval with a one-time password. Every signature is HMAC-SHA256 verified and NTP-timestamped.
features.cryptoDesc: Every document carries a SHA-256 hash. Verify authenticity via Document ID, QR code scan, or PDF upload — no login required.
features.deliveryDesc: Recipients receive a one-time link with OTP verification. Ownership confirmation, download tracking, and full delivery audit log included.
features.forensicDesc: Every action — generate, preview, approve, reject, deliver, verify — is logged immutably. Export full CSV audit reports with filters.

howSection.subtitle: A complete, automated workflow that eliminates manual document handling.

steps.createDesc: Build a document template with dynamic fields mapped to your data source.
steps.generateDesc: Select a record ID and generate a personalized PDF instantly or in bulk.
steps.requestDesc: Route the document to an approver with a secure one-time review link.
steps.esignDesc: Approver verifies identity with OTP and applies a cryptographic signature.
steps.deliverDesc: Recipient receives a one-time link and confirms ownership with OTP.
steps.verifyDesc: Anyone can verify authenticity via Doc ID, QR scan, or PDF upload.

securitySection.subtitle: Every document is cryptographically protected from generation to verification. Tampering is instantly detectable at any stage.

chain.hash: SHA-256 file hash stored at generation time — any tampering is detectable
chain.hmac: HMAC-SHA256 signature applied by the approver using a per-user secret key
chain.otp: OTP 2FA required for both approver sign-off and recipient identity confirmation
chain.jwt: JWT-secured single-use delivery tokens that expire after 7 days
chain.audit: Full immutable audit log — every action forensically recorded with timestamp

rolesSection.subtitle: Five distinct roles with purpose-built permission sets. Everyone sees only what they need.

roles.superAdminDesc: Full system control — templates, users, settings, audit, and all documents.
roles.systemAdminDesc: Manages templates and monitors operations without user/settings access.
roles.generatorDesc: Generates PDFs from templates and tracks their delivery status.
roles.approverDesc: Reviews pending documents and applies cryptographic e-signatures via OTP.
roles.recipientDesc: Receives delivered documents via secure link and confirms ownership.

verificationSection.subtitle: Enter a Document ID, upload the PDF, or scan the QR code to confirm authenticity and integrity in seconds.
